t: You're at St. John, a restaurant on St John Street in Smithfield, in a former bacon smokehouse. Fergus Henderson opened it in October 1994 with Trevor Gulliver and Jon Spiteri. As head chef, Henderson cooks nose to tail, so the menu leans on offal and cuts rarely seen elsewhere, such as pigs' ears, ducks' hearts, trotters and bone marrow. Many dishes come from traditional British cooking, and the wines are all French. Henderson trained as an architect. The restaurant won a Michelin star in 2012.
